title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Keepalive Scheduler Work Item
summary: Add an opt-in HTTP/3 server WebSocket keepalive interval that sends ping frames without blocking later tunnel data.
planned_changes:
- Add `Http3ServerOptions.WebSocketKeepAliveInterval` with positive-interval validation.
- Start and stop a per-tunnel keepalive task for accepted WebSocket tunnels.
- Serialize WebSocket tunnel writes so keepalive, application writes, and close frames cannot interleave.
- Add a loopback server test that observes a configured keepalive ping, sends a pong, and verifies later data still echoes.
verification_plan: Run the focused HTTP/3 minimal server WebSocket keepalive test, adjacent WebSocket regression tests, core SpecTrace validation, regenerated QUIC requirement triage, and diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: QUIC transport runtime, ACK, recovery, pacing, or packet-protection changes.
completion_notes: Accepted WebSocket tunnels can now opt into automatic server ping frames, with serialized writes preserving later tunnel data.
